evidence: c-Si (100) wafers coated with a 10 nm intrinsic a-Si:H film layer were used as substrates. They were prepared as follows: c-Si wafers (n-type, resistivity /C24 2–5 X cm) were cleaned with the standard RCA process 21 and dipped in 1% hydrofluoric acid solution for 2 min in order to remove the native oxide. The samples were then introduced into a plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD)-atomic layer deposition (ALD)-cluster tool, and a-Si:H layers were grown by PECVD from silane (SiH4) and hydrogen at a sample temperature of 200 /C14 C.
